invariants.rationale: The method only returns patch, which is only null if getRegion throws, but in that case an exception is thrown and nothing is returned.
The method returns either an explicitly constructed NinePatch or the result of optional(name, NinePatch.class), both of which ensure result is a NinePatch if returned.
The parameter 'name' is used for lookups and must be non-null for successful execution (indirectly enforced by method logic).
